reason: $29.99 for one month is more than Toplux or Goli and those last longer, and I am on $32k. Even $24.99 for the first box is a stretch for something I would have to keep rebuying every month.
objection: It costs more than the gummies I already know, and I would pay it again every month with no proof it does more for me.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $19 for the 30 days, or a two-box deal that brings it under $15 a box.
